design.quote: The aim of this study was to assess the level of evidence through a sensitivity analysis of the meta-analysis by Shah et al. (2024) using the Rebuilt the Evidence Base (REB) method.

population.quote: there is an evidence signal regarding the benefit of vitamin D supplementation in the population aged 75 and older

sample_size.quote: the analysis was performed on 8 RCTs at low risk of bias including 30 320 participants

intervention.quote: the effect of vitamin D supplementation on mortality reduction

comparator.quote: The main inclusion criterion was a double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT design.

primary_findings.quote: The results were statistically significant, in favor of vitamin D supplementation: RR = 0.96 (95% CI [0.92, 1.00]), p = 0.04.
